newsitem.title: GERMANY: Europe faces chaos if euro fails - Deutsche's Walter.
newsitem.headline: Europe faces chaos if euro fails - Deutsche's Walter.

text.p: The chief economist of Deutsche Bank AG, Germany's largest bank, said on Monday that Europe will slide into chaos if the single currency project fails.

Norbert Walter was quoted as saying in a radio interview that any attempts to change the entry conditions for European economic and monetary union (EMU) would destroy what little confidence Germans have in the planned single currency.

"If the euro fails and Europe then sinks into chaos one need not even talk about any future for Europe," Walter was quoted as saying in a summary of the interview which was released ahead of being broadcast on DeutschlandRadio Berlin.
The political will for monetary union now only existed in the top ranks of the political parties and in the German Chancellery, Walter said.

He added that Germany was a country of doubters and delayers which was inclined to shun the move into the single currency. He also called on the Bundesbank to send clearer signals of confidence than it had in the past.
